statement: The seed-owned formation-release handoff closure owner (src/control-plane/formation-release-handoff-closure-owner.js) mints a successor generation when a captured generation completes after the operation-ledger reopen has already been observed (authority not READY, recovery reason priority_partitions_not_spread) and connected JOINING members of the canonical set remain without a contract: a typed successor-capture admission (closed | completed_generation) opens at completion and admits exactly one capture on the next evaluation while isRetainableAuthority still holds, carrying the current publication epoch and the completed generation's fence and boot incarnation, non-authorizing until the durable readback, closed by that capture, by any revocation, or by the first incompatible or absent authority observation, so late joiners (run 2026-08-30T10-05-10: n3/n4 waited 55 s at waiting_for_startup_authority with formationReleaseHandoffState null) consume a contract through the unchanged CONSUMER validation and release at the same instant as cohort members instead of waiting for the raw three-way spread cure. The READY-gated capture, retention across a compatible reopen, cohort selection, revocation, consumer code, budgets, cadences, the 60-second window and the 120-second barrier are unchanged; nothing derives ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage. Proven deterministically on the real owner: red on HEAD (no successor, late joiner null), green after.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

Only the seed's formation-release closure owner mints a successor generation, and only on the evaluation after a captured generation completes, while isRetainableAuthority(authority, completedGeneration) still holds.

The successor admission is one typed variant (closed | completed_generation) closed by the successor capture, by any revocation, and by the first incompatible or absent authority observation; it never reopens without a new completion; repeated evaluations mint no generation, log no transition and issue no durable write; no candidates means no capture.

A successor captured under the reopen carries the current publication epoch and the completed generation's fence and boot incarnation, is non-authorizing until the durable readback, and is consumed only through the unchanged CONSUMER validation; no consumer/joiner code changes.

The READY-gated capture, retention across the compatible reopen, cohort selection from the canonical set, and member-loss/incarnation/substantive-block revocation are byte-for-byte unchanged; budgets, cadences, the 60-second GCP certification window and the 120-second barrier are unchanged; no sleeps.
Do not make the harness, analyzer, or readiness owner derive cluster-ACTIVE or READY from nodes.status, publication counts, or coverage.

Proof is a deterministic witness on the real closure owner reproducing run 2026-08-30T10-05-10 (reopen observed before gen-1 completes, two pre-ready candidates), red on HEAD (3/8) and green after (8/8), with the pre-reopen sequence and both pair witnesses as controls that must stay green; no GCP run is part of the proof.
